Verilerim nerede, kim görebilir?: Where is my data and who can see it?
Hesabına bağlı veriler (antrenman, öğün,: Data tied to your account (workouts, meals, routes, measurements) is stored in a secure cloud database and, through row-level access rules, is open only to your account. Your friends see only your XP and activity summary; your meal and measurement records stay hidden. For AI features (meal analysis from photos, Fit Coach, weekly review, equipment recognition), the information needed for a reply (the text you wrote or the photo you chose, plus a short summary of your profile, workouts and nutrition records) is sent to the AI provider. Meals you add by typing are mostly calculated from Hedefit's own food database; if an estimate is needed for a food not in the database, the text you typed may also go to the provider. Fit Coach may keep short notes in narrow categories such as your goal, preferences and constraints in its “memory”; these notes are deleted when you delete your account, and if you want them removed without deleting, you can write to the support address. Your username can be searched by other users who type at least 2 characters; you can turn this off with the “Appear in search” setting on the Friends screen.
